title: Projection of a Doob difference vanishes
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ whose constant-one element is indexed by $0$ and which is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. For a positive integer $n$, any real-valued function $f$ on $\Omega^n$, and any coordinate $t\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, projecting the difference between the Doob martingale at time $t$ and at time $t-1$ onto the first $t-1$ coordinates gives the zero function.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $\iota$ with decidable equality
A basis element indexed by $0$ is constant one
The basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
